model_organism.citation: RNA-Binding Protein Hnrnpa1 Triggers Daughter Cardiomyocyte Formation by Promoting Cardiomyocyte Dedifferentiation and Cell Cycle Activity in a Post-Transcriptional Manner (PMID: 39559922)
phenotypes: Inhibited cardiac regeneration
Worsened cardiac function in neonatal myocardial infarction model
Reduced Pbx1 expression regulation
Impaired cardiomyocyte dedifferentiation and cell cycle activity

model_organism.citation: A PBX1-IL7R axis mediates liver fibrosis in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (PMID: 40885520)
phenotypes: Myofibroblast-specific PBX1 depletion significantly attenuated liver fibrosis induced by CDAA-HFD
Liver injury and steatosis not influenced by PBX1 depletion
Reduced hepatic stellate cell activation

model_organism.citation: Development and function of the mammalian spleen (PMID: 17226804)
phenotypes: Asplenia or absent spleen
Defects in early splenic development and patterning
Reduced B cell populations involved in response to encapsulated bacteria
Increased susceptibility to infection with encapsulated bacteria

model_organism.citation: Dynamic evolution of TCF3-PBX1 leukemias at the single-cell level under chemotherapy pressure (PMID: 39901941)
phenotypes: TCF3-PBX1 fusion drives acute lymphoblastic leukemia development
CNS infiltration at relapse
Chemotherapy-resistant clones with altered apoptosis and signaling pathways
Upregulation of MYC signaling in persisting leukemic cells
Increased STAT3/5 phosphorylation upon preBCR stimulation

phenotypes: PBX1-d isoform expression in CD4+ T cells associated with systemic lupus erythematosus
Production of autoreactive activated CD4+ T cells
Reduced frequency and function of Foxp3+ regulatory T cells
Expansion of follicular helper T cells
Direct regulation of CD44 expression in T cells
Enhanced co-factor MEIS recruitment by PBX1-d over PBX1-b

Aberrant hyoid apparatus development with complete skeletal chain from neurocranium to lesser horns
Ectopic loci of mesenchymal condensations
Ectopic cartilage and bone formation
Disinhibition of skeletogenesis
Elevated proliferation of cartilage precursors
Reduced HAND2 expression in hyoid region

biological.citation: Cicero Predicts cis-Regulatory DNA Interactions from Single-Cell Chromatin Accessibility Data (PMID: 30078726)
biological.summary: PBX1 is identified as a transcription factor that, together with MEIS1, mediates early opening of DNA elements bound by MYOD1 in differentiating myoblasts. These PBX1- and MEIS1-dependent elements are part of chromatin hubs that orchestrate gene regulation during myoblast differentiation.

biological.citation: Rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus and primary Sjögren's syndrome shared megakaryocyte expansion in peripheral blood (PMID: 34462261)
biological.summary: PBX1 is identified as an upregulated cell-lineage-specific transcription factor that, together with GATA1, TAL1, and GFI1B, defines a strong gene expression signature of megakaryocyte expansion in peripheral blood of patients with rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and primary Sjögren's syndrome. PBX1 expression is associated with CD41b+CD42b+ and CD41b+CD61+ megakaryocyte subsets.
biological.sample_size: 119 treatment-naive patients (41 RA, 38 pSS, 28 SLE, 12 polyautoimmunity) and 20 healthy controls

biological.citation: The histone lysine acetyltransferase HBO1 (KAT7) regulates hematopoietic stem cell quiescence and self-renewal (PMID: 34724565)
biological.summary: PBX1 is identified as a gene essential for hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) quiescence and self-renewal. Loss of HBO1 results in downregulation of Pbx1 expression in HSC-enriched populations, leading to abnormal HSC recruitment into the cell cycle and exhaustion of the HSC pool. PBX1 is part of a transcription factor network critical for HSC maintenance.

biological.citation: Pre-B-cell leukemia transcription factor 1 contributes to liver fibrosis by enabling IL-7 signaling in HSC (PMID: 40080840)
biological.summary: PBX1 is upregulated during hepatic stellate cell (HSC) activation and mediates HSC-myofibroblast transition. PBX1 is transcriptionally activated by Notch3 signaling and directly activates IL7R (CD127) expression. PBX1 knockdown attenuates HSC activation in vitro and liver fibrosis in mice, while IL7R knockdown similarly impairs HSC activation.

biological.citation: RNA-Binding Protein Hnrnpa1 Triggers Daughter Cardiomyocyte Formation by Promoting Cardiomyocyte Dedifferentiation and Cell Cycle Activity in a Post-Transcriptional Manner (PMID: 39559922)
biological.summary: PBX1 is identified as a target of post-transcriptional regulation by Hnrnpa1, which promotes Mettl3 splicing to inhibit m6A-dependent Pbx1 degradation. Increased Pbx1 expression promotes cardiomyocyte dedifferentiation and cell cycle activity, triggering daughter cardiomyocyte formation and enhancing cardiac repair after myocardial infarction in mice.

biological.citation: Development of combination therapies with BTK inhibitors and dasatinib to treat CNS-infiltrating E2A-PBX1+/preBCR+ ALL (PMID: 38598725)
biological.summary: PBX1 is part of the oncogenic E2A-PBX1 fusion protein arising from t(1;19) translocation in acute lymphoblastic leukemia. E2A-PBX1+ ALL cells are sensitive to combination therapy with dasatinib and BTK inhibitors, which reduces CNS infiltration and improves disease-free survival in mouse models.
biological.sample_size: Primary ALL patient samples including E2A-PBX1+ cases

biological.citation: De novo, deleterious sequence variants that alter the transcriptional activity of the homeoprotein PBX1 are associated with intellectual disability and pleiotropic developmental defects (ASHG 2017)
biological.summary: Seven patients with de novo deleterious PBX1 variants (missense mutations in or near the homeodomain, and truncating mutations) present with intellectual disability and pleiotropic developmental defects including external ear anomalies, heart malformations, diaphragmatic hernia, renal hypoplasia, and cryptorchidism. Functional studies show these variants impair PBX1 transactivation ability, nuclear translocation, and interactions with TALE/HOX cofactors, directly affecting transcription of PBX1 target genes.

biological.citation: Interrogating the PBX-WNT-TP63 pathway in human nonsyndromic cleft lip/palate (ASHG 2013)
biological.summary: PBX1 and PBX2 variants are associated with nonsyndromic cleft lip/palate (NSCL/P) in human populations. PBX1 rs1044263 shows association with NSCL/P in Hispanic multiplex families (p=0.002). PBX genes are part of a regulatory module (PBX-WNT-TP63-IRF6) controlling facial morphogenesis, with loss of Pbx genes in mice resulting in fully penetrant cleft lip/palate phenotype.
biological.sample_size: 513 white non-Hispanic American families and 316 Hispanic families from Texas
biological.significance: p=0.002 for PBX1 rs1044263 in Hispanic multiplex families

biological.citation: A genome-wide association study reveals novel susceptibility loci for obesity in Saudi Arabs (ASHG 2013)
biological.summary: PBX1 (PRE-B-Cell leukemia homeobox 1) on chromosome 1 is identified as a novel susceptibility locus for obesity in a genome-wide association study of 5,418 Saudi Arabs, with 94 genome-wide significant SNPs reaching p<1×10-5 threshold.

biological.citation: Analysis of time-series embryonic diaphragm transcriptomes identifies Pbx1 as a candidate gene for diaphragmatic defects (ASHG 2011)
biological.summary: Pbx1 is identified as a candidate gene for congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) through time-series transcriptomic analysis of embryonic mouse diaphragms. Pbx1 knockout mouse embryos at E15.5 exhibit a range of diaphragmatic defects, validating Pbx1 as a CDH-associated gene. Pbx1 is known as a facilitator of muscle differentiation and mesodermal patterning during embryogenesis.
